title: Transaction Sequencing and House Price Pressures
authors: Morten Haabeth Grindaker; Artashes Karapetyan; Espen R. Moen; Plamen T. Nenov
eligible_reason: No binary staggered treatment. The regressors of interest are continuous: the change in the share of movers who buy before selling (dbuy_first_within_ss, with 8 lags) in local housing market x quarter panels, instrumented or used in local projections (reghdfe / ivreghdfe with absorb of location and time FE, aweight=mean_sales, cluster location_ID quarter), plus shift-share style aggregations and hedonic price indices. The ft_borusyak flag reflects shift-share (Borusyak-Hull-Jaravel) references, not DiD imputation.
design_notes: Norwegian housing-market (location_ID) x quarter panels built from Ambita transaction data 1993-2018 and Eiendomsverdi listings. main_results_table_HP.do / main_results_table_TOMs.do / Table2.do: reghdfe loghp_index_m`h' dbuy_first_within_ss L(1/8).dbuy_first_within_ss loghp_index_ss_`h' [aweight=mean_sales], absorb(`absorb') vce(cluster location_ID quarter); ivreghdfe for tightness/time-on-market; LP.do / LP_r1.do / LPR.do local projections; Generating_aggregated_data.do builds buy-first probabilities from micro data with reghdfe absorb(). Appendix tables: cross-sectional kappa regressions.

ineligible_specs.reason: continuous treatment (buy-first share changes), IV, local projections

data_files: Replication/Data/aggregated_data_quarterly.dta, aggregated_data_INVquarterly.dta, aggregate_data_month_to_quarter.dta, house_price_index*.dta, post_estimation_bydel.dta, Input/ (public series)
data_files_note: Aggregated market-level files are shipped; micro transaction data (Ambita, SSB registers) are proprietary and not included (Figure 2 / Table A1 need SSB access).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). All 76 regression commands inspected: none uses a binary adoption indicator.
